This plot is not mine, I only rent it, so I will not put my money into things that stay in the soil for the next person. I have no schooling, and here in Tabora most of us around me just plant with the seed we saved and hope the rains come good. Fertilizer costs too much for one bag and my plot is small, and last year I managed without it, so I will do the same this year. I will work it myself with my wife and the children when they are free, and maybe call two or three people for weeding when the grass gets ahead of me.
